question: Should TUI `/reasoning stream` render live thinking as a transient updating chat row, as footer/status text, or remain history-only with clearer copy?
rationale: Source inspection proves the TUI gap, but the reporter specifically asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer placement, so implementation would otherwise freeze a UX contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Show the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the later request but competing with existing run-state text.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation; fix copy so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking for retained thinking blocks.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the reasoning visibility contract this issue extends and are the best available owner for the UX/product choice.
